careers.title: Medical Doctor
careers.tagline: Heal people. Save lives. Lead in healthcare.
careers.description: Medical doctors diagnose and treat illnesses, working in hospitals, clinics and communities to improve health outcomes across South Africa.

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.tagline: Build the apps and systems that power the world.
careers.description: Software engineers design, build and maintain applications, websites and systems. One of the fastest-growing and highest-paying careers globally.

careers.title: Electrical Engineer
careers.tagline: Power cities, design smart systems, shape infrastructure.
careers.description: Electrical engineers design and develop electrical systems, from power grids to electronics and telecommunications networks.

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.tagline: Design bridges, roads and buildings that last centuries.
careers.description: Civil engineers plan and oversee construction of infrastructure — roads, dams, bridges and buildings that communities depend on every day.

careers.title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.tagline: Master numbers. Drive business decisions.
careers.description: Chartered Accountants manage financial records, audits and business strategy. The CA(SA) qualification is one of the most respected in Africa.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.tagline: Find hidden patterns in data that change decisions.
careers.description: Data scientists analyse complex datasets to help organisations make smarter decisions. One of the most in-demand roles of the 21st century.

careers.title: Professional Nurse
careers.tagline: Be the heartbeat of healthcare in your community.
careers.description: Nurses provide direct patient care, administer treatment and support recovery. Nursing is one of the most impactful and in-demand professions in South Africa.

careers.title: Teacher / Educator
careers.tagline: Shape the next generation of South African leaders.
careers.description: Teachers inspire, educate and mentor young people. Education is the most powerful tool for change — and South Africa needs great teachers urgently.

careers.title: Lawyer / Attorney
careers.tagline: Defend rights, pursue justice, change lives.
careers.description: Lawyers advise clients, draft legal documents and represent people in court. Law touches every part of society — business, human rights, family and beyond.

careers.title: Architect
careers.tagline: Design spaces where people live, work and dream.
careers.description: Architects design buildings and spaces, combining creative vision with technical precision. Every building you admire started as a sketch by an architect.

careers.title: Graphic Designer / UI Designer
careers.tagline: Turn ideas into visuals that move people.
careers.description: Graphic designers create visual content for brands, apps, websites and media. In the digital age, great design is more valuable than ever.

careers.title: Entrepreneur / Business Owner
careers.tagline: Build something from nothing. Create jobs. Leave a legacy.
careers.description: Entrepreneurs identify opportunities, take calculated risks and build businesses. South Africa needs bold founders who can solve local problems with local solutions.

careers.title: Agricultural Scientist
careers.tagline: Feed the nation. Secure South Africa's future.
careers.description: Agricultural scientists research and develop farming methods, food production and land management — critical for food security across Southern Africa.

careers.title: Social Worker
careers.tagline: Fight for the vulnerable. Transform communities.
careers.description: Social workers support individuals and families facing hardship — poverty, abuse, mental health and disability. One of the most meaningful careers in South Africa.

careers.title: Journalist / Media Producer
careers.tagline: Tell the stories that matter. Hold power accountable.
careers.description: Journalists investigate, report and broadcast news across print, radio, TV and digital media. In a democracy, journalists are essential to an informed society.

careers.title: Environmental Scientist
careers.tagline: Protect the planet. Shape sustainable futures.
careers.description: Environmental scientists study ecosystems, pollution and climate change — advising governments and companies on how to protect natural resources.

careers.title: Psychologist / Counsellor
careers.tagline: Help people understand themselves and heal.
careers.description: Psychologists study human behaviour and mental health, providing therapy, assessment and counselling to individuals, schools and organisations.

careers.title: IT / Network Administrator
careers.tagline: Keep the digital world connected and secure.
careers.description: IT administrators manage computer systems, networks and cybersecurity infrastructure — every organisation in the world depends on these professionals.

careers.title: Financial Analyst
careers.tagline: Turn numbers into strategy. Guide investment decisions.
careers.description: Financial analysts assess investment opportunities, build financial models and advise businesses and individuals on money management and growth strategies.

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.tagline: Design the machines that drive industry forward.
careers.description: Mechanical engineers design, build and maintain mechanical systems — from car engines to factory equipment and aerospace components.

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.tagline: The medication expert communities depend on.
careers.description: Pharmacists dispense medication, advise patients and ensure safe drug use. They are a critical part of the South African healthcare system.

careers.title: Game Developer
careers.tagline: Build interactive worlds that millions will explore.
careers.description: Game developers design and code video games — combining programming, storytelling and visual design into one of the world's most exciting industries.

careers.title: Marketing Manager
careers.tagline: Build brands people love. Tell stories that sell.
careers.description: Marketing managers develop strategies to promote products and services, manage campaigns and build brand identity across digital and traditional channels.

careers.title: Biomedical Scientist
careers.tagline: Research the science behind disease and treatment.
careers.description: Biomedical scientists conduct laboratory research on diseases, develop diagnostic tests and contribute to medical breakthroughs that save millions of lives.

careers.title: Urban & Regional Planner
careers.tagline: Design the cities and townships of tomorrow.
careers.description: Urban planners shape how towns and cities develop — deciding where homes, parks, transport routes and businesses go to create liveable, sustainable communities.
